description: This file defines the AccountsTester class used for acceptance testing in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM. It includes methods to create accounts directly in the database and through the UI for testing purposes.

classes.name: AccountsTester
classes.description: Acceptance test helper class for handling account-related test actions in SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates an account entry directly in the database with a given name and returns its ID.

methods.name: createAccountForElasticSearch
methods.description: Automates UI steps to create an account entry suitable for ElasticSearch indexing.

methods.name: getPublicScenario
methods.description: Returns the current test scenario object used in acceptance tests.
